destination.name: Ningbo
destination.tagline: A historic Zhejiang port city of old libraries, Chan temples and a riverside old quarter
destination.description: Ningbo is a major port city on the Yong River. Its old quarter holds Tianyi Pavilion, built in 1561 and one of China's oldest private libraries, and the Old Bund, a riverside district with a Catholic cathedral. Buddhist temples such as Tiantong and Temple of King Ashoka sit in the hills of Yinzhou, and Moon Lake and the Wang Shu-designed art museum on the Yongjiang add waterside corners.

goodToKnow.title: Use the metro
goodToKnow.detail: Sights are spread across Yinzhou, Jiangbei and Zhenhai. Ningbo has a metro network, so group stops by district.

goodToKnow.title: Temples are far out
goodToKnow.detail: Tiantong and King Ashoka temples lie in Yinzhou, outside the centre. Ashoka is about 20 km out, so go early.

goodToKnow.title: Summers are hot and humid
goodToKnow.detail: Plan outdoor stops for early morning or evening in summer, and expect the odd typhoon on the coast.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Ningbo is best in {months}, when days are milder than its hot, humid summers.
